STANDARD REFERENCE — APPLIANCE

Current Adopted Version: 2023
Governing Reference: CEC Title 20 2023

AHRI Directory: AHRI 1200-2013 as reference for commercial refrigeration
MAEDbS: CEC public appliance certification database
